answer: Each identity's usable standing is released only after a sequential, non-transferable custody period, and the release rate is super-linear in how many identities an operator runs, so a fleet cannot mature faster than one identity at a time. The cost of one more head is paid in full and is never amortised across the fleet. The forge is the serial tenure, the sable the custody window that must elapse, and the basalt the standing released at the end of it; the forge is personal, the sable is not skippable, and the basalt cannot be inherited by a sibling.
